nodes.name: Keen Edge
nodes.desc: +10% melee damage.

nodes.name: Fourth Strike
nodes.desc: Your ground combo gains a fourth, heavy hit.

nodes.name: Rising Cut
nodes.desc: Your up-slash launches small foes into the air.

nodes.name: Mattock Mastery
nodes.desc: Your downward strike deals 50% more damage.

nodes.name: Riposte
nodes.desc: A parry answers with a free heavy counter-cut.

nodes.name: Keener Edge
nodes.desc: Another +10% melee damage.

nodes.name: Bloodletting
nodes.desc: Each hit on a staggered foe heals you 2 HP.

nodes.name: Thrust
nodes.desc: Hold Attack, then let go: a charged lunge for half again a heavy hit.

nodes.name: Clear Mind
nodes.desc: +20 max MP.

nodes.name: Siphon
nodes.desc: Melee hits restore 50% more MP.

nodes.name: Deluge Pierce
nodes.desc: Water bolts pass through foes and strike every one in line.

nodes.name: Tilte Swarm
nodes.desc: Tilte throws three orbs in a fan, each 10 damage. Needs the Tilte scroll.

nodes.name: Thrift
nodes.desc: Spells cost 15% less MP.

nodes.name: Chain Thunder
nodes.desc: Thunder leaps from the foe it strikes to two more nearby.

nodes.name: Time Thief
nodes.desc: The Hour Glass holds time 1 s longer.

nodes.name: Mantra of Death
nodes.desc: The Death spell costs half its MP. Needs the Death scroll.

nodes.name: Deep Pockets
nodes.desc: +1 Red Potion charge.

nodes.name: Gold Sense
nodes.desc: Coins fly to you from farther away, and you find 10% more gold.

nodes.name: Quick Draught
nodes.desc: You drink a Red Potion 40% faster.

nodes.name: Second Stride
nodes.desc: Dash twice in the air before you land. Needs the Elven Stride.

nodes.name: Feather Fall
nodes.desc: After your double jump, hold Jump to glide down slowly. Needs the Wing Boots.

nodes.name: Treasure Sense
nodes.desc: The map marks rooms you know that still hold something to find.

nodes.name: Resilience
nodes.desc: +1 mask of health.

nodes.name: Last Stand
nodes.desc: Below 20% health, you take 25% less damage.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.desc: Once between rests, a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP.

nodes.name: Wanderer's Grace
nodes.desc: A dash lets harm pass through you 0.1 s longer, and every kill gives back your air dashes.
